property_summary: For the reference contract, the balance is always transferred to the sender when block.number is a multiple of 15 (and other conditions are met), never otherwise; the buggy contract triggers the transfer on multiples of 16 instead, so there exist block numbers where the transfer outcome differs.
change_summary: Change the divisor in the transfer condition from 15 to 16 so that the balance transfer triggers on a different block number cadence.
